title: EAP message reliable transport procedure accepted by the UE

entities.name: EAP message reliable transport procedure
entities.description: Procedure for reliable transport of EAP messages between UE and AMF using AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE messages.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to AMF containing EAP response messages for authentication.

entities.name: EAP message IE
entities.description: Information element carrying EAP request or response messages within AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE messages.

entities.name: Timer T3560
entities.description: Timer used by AMF to monitor response time for authentication procedures.

entities.name: EAP-request message received
entities.description: Condition where UE receives an EAP-request message from the network.

entities.name: AMF handles EAP message
entities.description: Action performed by AMF when processing EAP message received in AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.

relations.description: Procedure includes creating and sending AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message
AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains EAP message IE
When EAP-request is received, UE sets EAP message IE to EAP-response
Receipt of AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message stops timer T3560
Presence of EAP message IE in AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE triggers AMF to handle EAP message
